prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Preset fast-track adoption flows, moving sign-in after pet adoption, photo quality callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views were helpful.
Spotlight welcome layouts, background notification prompts, account sync banners, post-adoption certificate sign-in placement, desktop diagnostic flows, playful starter hubs, and carousel choice card layouts showed no clear effect.
Path decision speed helper callouts performed worse than the control.
Predictions were too low for photo quality callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.
Predictions were too high for preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in reordering, tests with no clear effect, and changes that worsened performance.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +10.2% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +9.3% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +8.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -3.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +3.7% over 2 test(s)
- finish, layout: +6.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -3.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -1.9% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +3.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +7.8% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +1.9% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.3% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 82.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 75.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 27.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Waiting Final Account Sign-In Placement: Moves sign-in screen to trigger immediately after pet rendering finishes on the waiting screen, right before desktop launch. (why: Users face significant total onboarding time (mean 5815s) and sign-in drop-off; delaying auth until the pet is fully rendered boosts motivation.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Interaction Hints during Waiting: Displays interactive tips on the waiting screen showing desktop controls such as dragging, hiding, and right-clicking the pet. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide the pet once created, and waiting average time is high (2336s mean).)
2: [choose_path, copy] Path Choice Flexibility & Multi-Pet Reassurance: Updates headline and subtext on path selection to clarify that users can add more pets or switch adoption paths later. (why: Choose path takes a mean 514s and drops 18.0% of users, indicating decision paralysis during path selection.)
3: [home, notification] Render Completion Audio Notification Cue: Triggers a audio alert sound component on the waiting screen to notify users when pet generation is complete. (why: Waiting stage median duration is 201s with long tail (mean 2336s); sound alerts pull distracted users back to complete onboarding.)
